title: Screenshot Blackmail
scenario: Someone threatens to share an edited image unless you send money or more photos.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Screenshot Blackmail: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Do not negotiate; save evidence and tell a trusted adult.
